tools.name: intent_match
tools.description: The first call: says whether the user's request is a flow JOBFLOW already runs. A match answers do_not_build true, the capabilities it touches and the next call; no match answers 404 OUT_OF_SCOPE. Never: Guess: it names the words it matched. Free.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Catalog, schemas, fees, gate, error codes; with a trade, the field knowledge for it. Never: —. Free.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: The hard platform fee for a capability before it is called, with what is left of the daily cap. Never: Estimate the value of a job. Free.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Build-vs-buy next to the hard fee, the estimate marked NOT_A_QUOTE. Never: Present a token count or an estimate as a fact. Free.

tools.name: mandate_create
tools.description: Creates a mandate and the out-of-band approval link for the owner. Never: Activate production. Free.

tools.name: flow_configure
tools.description: The WhatsApp-to-payment flow for this mandate as a configuration proposal. Never: Bind a channel or an account without an approved mandate. Free.

tools.name: intake_classify
tools.description: Classifies a customer request and opens the flow (REQUEST → CLASSIFIED). Never: Set an emergency tariff. Platform fee CHF 0.05 per accepted call: quote first, then send quote_id, mandate_token and idempotency_key.

tools.name: job_create
tools.description: Creates the order from the classification. Needs state CLASSIFIED. Never: Take a price from the request body. Platform fee CHF 0.05 per accepted call: quote first, then send quote_id, mandate_token and idempotency_key.

tools.name: assign
tools.description: Assigns a technician by the business's rule. Needs state ORDER. Never: Treat free text as dispatching. Platform fee CHF 0.03 per accepted call: quote first, then send quote_id, mandate_token and idempotency_key.

tools.name: schedule
tools.description: Books the earliest free slot in the business's working windows. Needs state ASSIGNED. Never: Use the agent's calendar as the source. Platform fee CHF 0.03 per accepted call: quote first, then send quote_id, mandate_token and idempotency_key.

tools.name: proof_seal
tools.description: Hashes and closes the proof pack after the work is completed. Needs state WORK_COMPLETED. Never: Issue the invoice. Platform fee CHF 0.05 per accepted call: quote first, then send quote_id, mandate_token and idempotency_key.

tools.name: invoice_issue
tools.description: Issues the invoice from the business's tariff and the reported work, only after the proof pack. Needs state PROOF_PACK. Never: Invent a price or skip the gate. Platform fee CHF 0.18 per accepted call: quote first, then send quote_id, mandate_token and idempotency_key.

tools.name: payment_collect
tools.description: Creates the payment request for the invoice (QR bill, TWINT, card). The flow reaches PAYMENT only on the signed event of the payment provider. Needs state INVOICE. Never: Mark anything paid or pay out without a settled status. Platform fee CHF 0.10 per accepted call: quote first, then send quote_id,

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Checks a chain: links, payload hashes and signatures. Never: Require a UI. Free.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search everything JOBFLOW knows for agents: field knowledge per trade (what to ask, emergency signals, evidence, rules, pitfalls), every component with its price and what it replaces, the guarantees, agent pricing and how to run a real business. Returns ids with citable URLs; read one with fetch. Fr

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one document from search, with its URL for citation. Free.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: compare, fetch · Public sink: intake_classify, job_create, assign, schedule, proof_seal, invoice_issue, payment_collect · Destructive: search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: compare, fetch · Public sink: intake_classify, job_create, assign, schedule, proof_seal, invoice_issue, payment_collect · Destructive: search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
